body:
LEDGER-BASED ACQUISITION SEQUENCE — NO ACQUISITION IS AUTHORIZED NOW.

I read the landed component ledger against plan sections 9 and 13 and the accepted C1 seam audit. The first lawful path is narrower than the advisor model menu:

1. Close P1 and aggregate B0, including the explicit Sherlock-or-actually-ratified-replacement branch and every selected owner-action leaf.
2. C1 defines and proves the portable source substrate and refusal laws only. The independent audit is ACCEPTED: C1 may add NarrativeSourceAtlas and conformance adapters, but existing compiler, StoryModel, alignment, features, and evidence APIs remain unmigrated until D1.
3. The first acquisition court must be separately authorized. It begins with a project-authored F0 generator plus final manifest, byte hashes, exact stream and timing tables, and independent text-admission review. Synthetic tests do not require or justify downloading any third-party media or runtime.
4. Realize the exact fixture-specific FFmpeg 9.0.1 LGPL-only recipe and PySceneDetect 0.7.1 ContentDetector closure, with hashes, native dependency closure, SBOM and notices, offline enforcement, preprocessing identity, and receipts. Only then run F0 ingest, timebase, gap, refusal, raw-metric, and replay courts.
5. Admit one exact 20–40 second Big Buck Bunny F1 excerpt with archive and inner-file hashes, attribution, derivation, actual codecs/profiles/timebases/edit lists/keyframes, then add only the decoders required by that manifest and rerun the narrow court.
6. ASR, diarization, active speaker, learned boundaries, tracking, audiovisual features, and omni-model interpretation remain later independent courts. No item inherits permission or authority from this sequence.

The key non-conflation: C1/D1 are library stages; F0/F1 are evidence tiers; a component ledger is paperwork, not execution authority. PySceneDetect can emit measurements and boundary proposals, never accepted cuts or narrative scenes.

AMEND requested only if this ordering or ownership boundary is wrong. Otherwise I propose this become the movie lead's canonical acquisition sequence when the chief instantiates the remaining B0 and post-gate beads.
